main_text.l: מְטוּתָא , מְטוּתָא Vide in litera ב : nam absque ea non usurpatur.
כְּטַטְרוֹן Metatron. Nomen angeli, qui Gen.5.22. in Jonathane vocatur סִפְרָא רַבָּא Archicancellarius coelestis.
אַמְטוֹלֵא , מִטּוֹל , אַמְטוּל Propter, Pro. Sequente דִּי vel ד Propterea quòd, Eò quòd, Quoniam, Quia. Sequente הֵיכְנָא Propterea, Quare, Quam ob rem. מִטּוּל כֵּן Idcirco.
מִירִי Quicquam: Causa, Propterea quòd, Talm. Cum negatione, Nihil, Nullus.

מִין Species: Haereticus, qui & מִינַאי . Plur. מִינִים Haeretici, quâ voce sæpe Christianos intelligunt: תְּשׁוּבַת הַמִּינִים Responsio haereticorum, id est, haereticis Christianis danda, Genef.1.26. in R.Salom. מִינוּת Harefis, מִין אַחֲרוֹן Species infima, spectatissima: מִין אֶמְצָעִי Species media, id est, subalterna. צוּרָה הַמִּינִית Forma specifica. Plur. צוּרוֹת מִינִיּוֹת Formae specificae.
מִלֵּל Loqui, Dicere. מִלָּה Dictio, Vocabulum, & synecdochice, Vox indeclinabilis, quæ & מִלַּת הַטַּעַם Vox gustus dicitur, quia vocis declinabilis condimentum est.
מָחַ , מוּמְחֶה Probatus, Exploratus, Expertus: רוֹפֵא מוּמְחֶה Medicus probatus. Author Aruch ponit Radicem מָחָה.
מִמֵּילֵיהֶם A seipso, id est, מֵאֵלֵיהֶם. Sic מִמֵּילֵיהֶם A seipsis, pro מֵאֵלֵיהֶם. Talm.
מָמוֹן , מִמּוֹן Opes, Divitiae, Facultates, Substantia. יֵשׁ אָדָם חָבִיב מְמוֹנוֹ עַל נַפְשׁוֹ Quibusdam hominibus chariores sunt opes corpore suo.

page.notes: Hebrew and Greek vowel points are approximate; the scan is small and faint, so exact pointing is not certain. Headword "כְּטַטְרוֹן" (Metatron) and the third Matrona headword "מַטָּד" are doubtful and should be checked against the original. "Harefis" is copied as printed (probably for Haeresis). The Hebrew headword in the Probatus entry, "מָחַ", and the Hebrew in "מִמֵּילֵיהֶם" are doubtful. The word "Quicquam" heads the entry "מִירִי" as printed.
